ema3.cadence: Twice weekly initially, then weekly; daily only for an explicit short burst
ema3.description: 3-item ecological momentary assessment reported separately from the structural GiveCare Score.
ema3.title: EMA-3 Reading

gc_sdoh30.cadence: Triggered when inverted GC-SDOH-6 domain scores are below 40 on the 0-100 GiveCare Score scale
gc_sdoh30.description: 30-item deep-dive instrument aligned to GC1-GC6 domains (5 questions per domain). Administered selectively per flagged domain, not as a full battery. Informed by PRAPARE/AHC-HRSN methodology.
gc_sdoh30.title: GC-SDOH-30

gc_sdoh6.description: Quick 6-question baseline assessment covering social determinants of health for caregivers. One question per domain, deficit-framed (0=none, 4=extreme).
gc_sdoh6.title: GC-SDOH-6

meta.description: SMS-administered caregiver assessment instruments used by GiveCare

composite.name: GiveCare Score
composite.normalization: Deficit-framed SDOH items are inverted before domain and composite scoring; EMA-3 is excluded.
composite.sdoh30_trigger: Trigger deep-dive questions for domains scoring below 40 on the inverted 0-100 scale.

scoring.method: GiveCare Score uses GC-SDOH-6 as its structural base and completed GC-SDOH-30 questions to refine matching GC domains. EMA-3 is normalized separately as an EMA-3 reading.
